note: A rectified street-panorama crop of one Amsterdam house front; the house in question fills the image.

scaffold.instructions: Is there scaffolding, a construction hoarding or a builder's cover in front of the house front in `facade`?

criteria.true: Scaffolding or a hoarding covers part of the front.

van.instructions: Does a van, truck or large vehicle stand in front of the house front in `facade` and hide part of it (not a small car at the kerb)?

criteria.true: A van or truck hides part of the front.
criteria.false: No van or truck in front of the front.

trunk.instructions: Does a tree trunk or a lamp post stand in front of the house front in `facade` and hide a vertical strip of it?

criteria.true: A tree trunk or post blocks part of the front.
criteria.false: No trunk or post in front of the front.

branches.instructions: Do bare tree branches or twigs cross in front of the house front in `facade`?

boat.instructions: Is a moored boat, houseboat or barge in front of the house front in `facade`?

criteria.true: A boat hides part of the front.
